hook.name: Fomo4DHook
hook.description: A FoMo3D-inspired jackpot game hook for Uniswap v4. Buyers of KEY4D tokens earn round credit and extend a countdown timer; when the timer expires, Chainlink VRF selects a weighted winner from the last 128 qualifying buys. The hook applies a dynamic buy tax that steepens as the round nears expiry, with ETH-side fees funding the jackpot and KEY-side fees burned.
